description: Keep long, image-heavy Codex and Claude Code chats fast: earlier images become ID placeholders the model fetches back on demand, even after compaction. Local, cache-friendly, MIT.
summary: A local plugin for image-heavy chats in Codex, Claude Code and other AI agents: earlier images become short placeholders instead of going out with every message, the model fetches the original back by its ID (also after compaction), and the prompt cache keeps working.
